Summarize a condor_workflow.py run

summarize_group_embedding_run.Rd

Reads the output directory of condor_workflow.py's five-stage Condor pipeline (package inst/condor/; see vignette("condor_workflows_vignette")'s Workflow 1, and run_group_embedding_workflow for the local, non-Condor equivalent) and writes a self-contained Markdown report with one section per stage: the dimensionality search, the learning curve, the crowd-kernel warm-start fit, alpha estimation, and the final-final production fit – each with the plots this project has repeatedly needed by hand after a real Condor run (loss/accuracy vs. dimension or fraction, training curves, restart stability, the alpha trajectory, and the recovered embedding's own geometry). The same report-generation idea as summarize_joint_estimation, for this package's other Condor workflow.

Usage

summarize_group_embedding_run(
  output_dir,
  item_colors = NULL,
  output_md = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

output_dir

Path to a condor_workflow.py output directory (must contain run_manifest.txt).

item_colors

Character vector, same length and row order as the production embedding, or NULL (default): colors for the embedding-geometry plots. With no dataset-specific semantics available in general, the default colors items by row position via rainbow; pass a semantically meaningful vector for a more informative plot.

output_md

Path to write the Markdown report to. Default file.path(output_dir, "summary.md"). Figures are written as PNG files to a sibling <name>_files/ directory and referenced with relative paths, so the report is self-contained if copied as a unit.

verbose

Logical, print progress. Default TRUE.

Value

Invisibly, the parsed run as a named list (see the source of read_group_embedding_run() for its fields) – mainly useful for follow-up inspection in an interactive session. Also writes output_md and its figures as a side effect.

Details

Stages 2 (learning curve), 4 (alpha estimation), and 5 (final-final fit) are optional in condor_workflow.py itself (run_learning_curve: false / refit_alpha: false in its config) – this function detects their absence from output_dir directly (rather than trusting run_manifest.txt's own fields, which an older run may not have) and writes a short note in place of that stage's section instead of failing. When stages 4-5 were skipped, best_embedding.csv (stage 3) is reported as the production embedding instead of best_final_embedding.csv, matching vignette("condor_workflows_vignette")'s own convention.
